subject: Stage variance & commit conversion — playbook and training
messages:
From: Alice Johnson <alice@acmeanalytics.com>
To: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 30 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Q: recent stage drop / commit conversion for Acme 

Hi Vivek,

Quick note from our side after the monthly forecast review — we saw a larger-than-expected drop from Pipeline -> Best Case and then Commit for three deals that were previously classified as Best Case. Before we update our numbers I wanted to confirm how Redwood is thinking about stage hygiene for these account types (enterprise, multi-region).

Specifics attached: stage-variance-snapshot.csv — two deals are timing pushes, one was requalified as lower probability after an internal procurement hold. The buyer is asking why their renewal got reclassified and needs a simple explanation for their CFO.

Can your team share the updated commit definition checklist and any guidance we should pass back to the buyer? Also — is there room for a short training session for our reps on commit-conversion criteria so we don't see repeat reclassifications next quarter?

Thanks,
Alice Johnson
Head of Analytics Partnerships
Acme Analytics
alice@acmeanalytics.com

---
Attachment: stage-variance-snapshot.csv (CSV, 12KB)

From: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
To: Alice Johnson <alice@acmeanalytics.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 31 May 2027 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Q: recent stage drop / commit conversion for Acme 

Alice — thanks for the summary and the CSV. Appreciate the clear ask.

Short answer: yes, we have an updated commit checklist and a lightweight playbook that teams can follow when a deal moves from Best Case -> Commit (or vice versa). The playbook focuses on three triggers: procurement confirmation, signed SOW/PO timeline, and technical blockers. When a procurement hold appears, the default is to move the deal back to Pipeline and attach a requalification note.

I've drafted a one-page playbook (commit_playbook_v1.pdf) and a suggested script your CSMs can use when explaining reclassification to buyers. I propose a 30-minute training session targeted at quota-carrying reps + AMs to walk through the checklist and run two short roleplay scenarios.

Proposed next steps: 
- Marissa to coordinate a 30-min workshop this week for Acme sellers and Redwood AMs.
- Kar thik to share the playbook doc and updated HubSpot fields that must be filled during requalification.
- Vivek to join the first 10 minutes for alignment and introduce the policy.

Marissa — can you confirm availability Thursday or Friday this week? Alice — which of your sellers should join (name + role)?

Regards,
Vivek Kulkarni
VP, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
vivek@redwood.com
